headline: Isoform and polyadenylation-site resolution extends to single-cell, long-read and proteomic readouts
label: Isoform Resolved Transcriptome Tooling
summary: New APA tools, a long-read polyadenylation atlas and an aging isoform atlas tie transcript-level resolution to single-cell, structural and protein-level interpretation.
synthesis: The dominant thread is resolving transcript-level features, especially alternative polyadenylation and isoform usage, and tying them to interpretation. scPolyA brings agent-guided APA analysis to single-cell and spatial 3' transcriptomes, while IsoAPA catalogs 2.3M transcript-resolved polyadenylation sites from PacBio and Nanopore data across 816 sample groups. A mouse atlas of age-associated differential transcript usage in brain, liver and adipose reports mostly regulatory isoform switching and uses BioEMU to test structural effects. R2T2P links genome-guided assembly to translation profiling and proteomics to find novel RNAs in an FSHD cellular model. What is new is the coupling of isoform resolution with interactive or agent-guided tooling, structural modeling and protein-level validation. The perturbation screens, spatial velocity, meta-analysis and surfaceome items are adjacent rather than isoform-focused.
